questions.question:
D2 — Issue 1: make Save the visible primary action?
Project/branch/task: main, Settings Page plan review, Pass 1 Information Architecture.
ELI10: Right now Save, Reset, Cancel and Export are four identical buttons. A user has to read every label to find the one they came for. DESIGN.md already says Save is the only filled primary button and the other three are neutral ghost buttons. Stakes if wrong: people mis-click Reset or Cancel, hit the discard dialog, and lose trust in the form.
Recommendation: 1A because DESIGN.md prescribes the exact treatment and it reuses the existing Button variants.
Completeness: 1A=10/10, 1B=6/10, 1C=3/10
1A) Save filled primary (#1d4ed8, white), Reset/Cancel/Export ghost (recommended) (human: ~1h / CC: ~5min)
  ✅ One filled button in the row means the primary action is found in the 3-second scan
  ✅ Reuses existing Button primary and ghost variants; zero new CSS tokens
  ❌ Export loses visual weight, so export-heavy users find it one beat slower
1B) Save primary plus Export as an outlined secondary; Reset/Cancel ghost (human: ~2h / CC: ~10min)
  ✅ Keeps Export discoverable as a distinct second tier
  ✅ Still gives Save the only filled treatment
  ❌ Adds a third button tier DESIGN.md does not define; new token to maintain
1C) Leave all four identical
  ✅ No implementation work
  ✅ Zero risk of regressing button styles elsewhere
  ❌ Documented violation ships; primary action stays invisible
Net: 1A trades a hair of Export prominence for an unmistakable primary action and zero new tokens.

options.label: 1A: Save filled primary, others ghost (recommended)
options.description: Apply DESIGN.md tokens: Save #1d4ed8 filled with white text; Reset, Cancel, Export neutral ghost. Reuse existing Button variants.

options.label: 1B: Save primary, Export outlined secondary
options.description: Adds a third tier not in DESIGN.md. Requires a new token.

options.label: 1C: Leave all four identical
options.description: Decline the fix; gap stays documented and lowers the score.
